correctness.rationale: Full tetrahedron nonempty-face Hasse diagram has 15 nodes and 28 cover arrows. I independently enumerated every disjoint acyclic arrow matching (12,820 nonempty simplices), confirming f-vector (28,300,1544,3932,4632,2128,256) and all S4 signed chain Lefschetz values (100,2,0,1,0) for class representatives. Scoville Theorem 20/Table 2 puts reduced rational homology only in degree 4 with rank 99, whence subtract H0=1 to obtain (99,1,-1,0,-1). Character inner products with S4 irreducibles and class sizes (1,6,3,8,6) yield multiplicities (4,13,8,12,4), total dimension 99. The oriented-simplex signs were included. No larger n or integral representation statement.
residual_risks: The finite calculation does not supply an integral Z[S4]-lattice decomposition; Scoville’s homology concentration is cited as an input.
